description: SDG  6.2.1 Proportion of Population Using Safely Managed Sanitation Services, Including a Hand-washing Facility with Soap and Water is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. SDG indicator 6.2.1: proportion of population using safely managed sanitation services, population practising open defecation, and population with basic handwashing facilities, by urban/rural area, Qatar, 2016-2022. "Not applicable" is shown for rural areas (Qatar has no rural areas in this classification). Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are handwashing, sanitation. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
